description: Iraq used sulfur mustard against Iran in the 1980-88 war. Over 100,000 soldiers without gas masks were injured; roughly 45,000 still suffer consequences, and about 30,000 exposed Iranians have been followed as a study population.
energy_note: Forty years of a fortnight in 1986.
source_name: Balali-Mood & Darchini-Maragheh, Iran J Med Sci 2018

aspect: Delayed keratopathy - going blind two decades later
description: The eye is the most sensitive organ to sulfur mustard. Beyond the acute injury, a severe rapid-onset keratitis develops in a proportion of patients after a latent period of 15-20 years, causing permanent damage. Survivors live those twenty years knowing it may be coming.
energy_note: Waiting two decades to find out about your own eyes.
source_name: Long-term ocular complications literature; Sardasht cohort

description: Now considered the main pathological feature and the major cause of respiratory complication. Chronic bronchitis in 58.9% and asthma in 10.6% of one severely intoxicated cohort; imaging consistent with BO documented as late as 25 years post-exposure. Respiratory disease is the leading cause of long-term disability.
energy_note: Breathing as a daily, deteriorating project.

aspect: The psychiatric load sits on top, and was measured separately
description: The Sardasht-Iran Cohort Study compared 367 chemically exposed civilians against 128 from Rabat who had been exposed to intensive conventional warfare but not chemical weapons - isolating the chemical effect from general war trauma. Elevated somatisation, depression, anxiety, hostility, phobic anxiety, paranoid ideation and psychoticism.
energy_note: Worse than the war, and they had a control group for it.

aspect: Sexual dysfunction is in the clinical literature and out of the conversation
description: Documented alongside depression, mood disorder, anxiety and PTSD in chemical warfare survivors. It is the effect least likely to be raised by the patient and least likely to be asked about by the clinician.
energy_note: A documented symptom nobody in the room will name.
notes: Compounds the psychological material in assets/text/iran on sexual dissatisfaction and its downstream effect on work and enterprise.

aspect: Skin: chronic itch on old scars, and cancer risk
description: Persistent pruritus on decades-old lesions, multiple cherry angiomas, hypo- and hyperpigmentation, and susceptibility to skin cancers. The itch is the one that ruins sleep, permanently.
energy_note: Scratching a 1986 burn at three in the morning in 2026.

aspect: SECONDARY - the family runs a hospice for forty years
description: A progressively breathless, itching, sleepless, partially sighted parent is cared for at home by a spouse and children across decades. Their lives are structured around it and their own outcomes are never studied.
money_note: Foregone earnings of family carers over decades.
energy_note: A childhood spent as nursing staff.
